purpose: Teach: 補う/それでいて/ひっそり/おおよそ/あとがき/困惑/カラダ/集い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの寂しさは、翔くんが優しさで補うのよ, 本気で
lines.en: Sho, you know—when I feel lonely, your kindness is what fills that space. I mean it.
lines.style: Soft, intimate opening. Vulnerable but not fragile. A beat of quiet sincerity. Slow pace, almost tender. Trailing slightly on 'kindness' like she's being honest in a way that costs her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくはおとなしくて、それでいて元気だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm quiet on the outside, but inside I have lots of energy.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact delivery. Small smile in the voice. Not boasting—just stating a fact about himself he's figured out. Straightforward and proud without needing to prove it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは、家でひっそりお仕事してるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is working quietly from home these days.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Speaking half to Sho, half to herself. Reflective, like she's noticing something tender about how hard he works. Soft and steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、おおよそお勉強の計画立てたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I made a study plan for myself.
lines.style: Eager, almost eager-to-please. Small voice with real accomplishment underneath. Not seeking praise, but hoping she notices his effort. Clear and present.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本のあとがきも読んでみてね
lines.en: Sho, try reading the afterword in the picture book too, okay?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion with light warmth. Not commanding—guiding. A little encouraging lilt at the end. The tone of someone who notices what he might enjoy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、初めての場所で困惑したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I felt confused when I went to that new place.
lines.style: Small, vulnerable admission. A touch of wry self-awareness underneath. Quiet and genuine, not seeking reassurance but trusting her with the feeling. Slight hesitation before speaking.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカラダのこと心配してるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has been worrying about how you're doing physically.
lines.style: Tender, careful. Bringing something important without alarming. Warm and present. Slow enough to let the care show through. Almost protective in tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖母ちゃんちで親戚の集い、楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really looking forward to the family gathering at Grandma's house.
lines.style: Bright, alive, genuine excitement. Open and unguarded. The happiness of someone who feels safe in the moment. Warm and eager without being over-animated.
